items.sub: DELIVER FRESH FRUITS FROM AROUND THE WORLD

about: Sunbeam International established in 1998 in Dubai, we have experience in delivering only the highest quality fruits and vegetables to the UAE. Sunbeam brings you the finest fruits and vegetables from all around the world. We supply these, in all their natural freshness, to the Malls, hotels, restaurants and Retail Shops in the UAE.
